issues: Header component renders navigation links as <Link> elements both in header and inside the mobile menu, causing duplicate links with the same name (e.g., "Services"). Tests that query by role "link" and name find multiple matches, leading to failures. Fix by rendering navigation links only once in the header (outside the conditional mobile menu) and using a separate button element for the mobile menu toggle without duplicating the links.

Header renders the "Book a consultation" button as a <Link> with role="button" but also includes a duplicate link in the mobile menu, causing duplicate "Contact" links. Remove the duplicate from the mobile menu or restructure to avoid duplicate link elements.

Header uses a <Link to="#"> for the Menu button, which is semantically incorrect and gives insufficient color contrast (white text on teal background). Change the Menu button to a <button> element styled as a button and ensure its foreground/background colors meet WCAG AA contrast (e.g., use navy text on white or teal background with sufficient contrast).

Primary button styles (white text on teal background) do not meet the required contrast ratio (4.14:1 < 4.5:1). Update CSS to use a darker teal or adjust text color to meet the 4.5:1 contrast for large text.

Responsive layout tests fail because the page width exceeds 390px on mobile (elements are too wide). Adjust container widths, margins, and paddings in CSS to ensure max-width: 100% and no horizontal overflow at 390px viewport.

Home page hero and other sections lack appropriate semantic landmarks (e.g., missing <header>, <nav>, <main> within the page components). Ensure each page wraps content in <main> and uses <section> with appropriate ARIA landmarks if needed.
Contact page form does not clear fields after successful submission and may not prevent network requests properly. Ensure the form state is reset and no fetch call is made on submit.

wrong_tests.test: Header contains wordmark, navigation links, and booking button
wrong_tests.reason: The test expects a unique link named /services/i, but the required footer also contains a link with the same name, causing multiple matches. This conflict cannot be resolved without removing required UI elements, so the test contradicts the specification.
wrong_tests.fix: Modify the test to query within the header region (e.g., using within(header).getByRole('link', ...) ) instead of the whole document.

feedback: Multiple failures stem from duplicate navigation links in header and footer, insufficient color contrast, and layout overflow. Refactor Header to avoid duplicated links, use proper button elements, adjust CSS for contrast and mobile width, and ensure form handling clears fields without network calls.
